markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (96%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set is InSitu only; MUSK and all five neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 96%, Invasive 4% | Clear separation |
| Conformal set | InSitu only (90%) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 1.0 | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 InSitu | Neighbors agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 5, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; linked to lower invasive likelihood [F2] · Weak
- **Scarce benign stroma or fat** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score; linked to invasive carcinoma [F4] · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↑ invasive · High score; modest invasive association · Unreliable
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↓ invasive · Near-typical score; slightly lower invasive association · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Top-3 region deletion drops the invasive logit 0.54 beyond random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; unproven. Necrosis (3/20) and normal lobules (0/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated stain degradation (severity 3) goes unnoticed; reliability AUROC is only 0.69 (CI 0.58–0.87).
- Calibration is dataset-level only (ECE 0.05, CI 0.03–0.18), so 4% invasive is approximate.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 9, 10** — highest per-region invasive risk (59%, 57%, 68%); look for stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 7, 8, 11** — confirm necrosis; its spot check was 3/20.
3. **Regions 0, 5, 10** — confirm atypical cells stay within ducts (12/20 spot check).
